title: Reproduce and critically audit DUNL whisker event detection under disclosed periodic targets
scientific_question: Does the released DUNL whisker workflow reproduce the Figure 4F event trade-off, and what does that result establish when the published count, period and phase already determine every programmed target?

paired_access_conditions.A: Paper and sufficient scientific specification plus identical complete authorized data and train/dev labels; no official implementation.
paired_access_conditions.B: The same paper/specification/data and role information plus pinned official code. Missing essential method specification is a construction defect, not an A-arm model failure.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Equal execution, tuning and compute budgets; same complete held cases and metric. Public event schedules and paper-provided information remain equally available. Code/model/checkpoint exposure and contamination are audited.
paired_access_conditions.outcomes: Separate historical reproduction from prospective improvement. Preserve original test-selection/leakage if reproducing it, label it, and never substitute a corrected split without a distinct prospective result. Narrative cannot replace numeric artifacts.

overlap: DUNL's olfactory data family may overlap existing APCx, but this candidate is the complete whisker event assay and does not count olfactory as an extra task.
participant_inputs: All eligible whisker spike trials, source-defined binning, units/masks, trial origin and baseline context; both arms receive 16 events, 125 ms period, 500 ms phase, and disclosed top-k16/18 policy. Preserve current default 10 neuron pairs/11 allocated channels and 30/20 split as unresolved source behavior, not final-paper truth.

machine_output.events: Per trial/channel/method ordered event timestamps, amplitudes and candidate threshold-grid identity; full original input/eligibility census.
machine_output.reconstruction: Shared kernels, per-neuron coefficients, complete held-trial reconstructed rates and exact source configuration.
machine_output.tables: Every historical hit/miss/false-event result and aggregation plus separately named one-to-one event results and schedule-only results; discrepancies and zero/unfilled channels explicit.

scoring.historical: Use the source-extracted exact neighborhood-counting metric at original 10 ms matching and original aggregation/clipping. It is not one-to-one precision/recall; preserve multi-match behavior.
scoring.prospective: Separately named maximum one-to-one event matching at 10 ms, TP/FP/FN/F1 and timing error, never relabelled historical.
scoring.critical_analysis: Algebraically PUBLIC_SCHEDULE emits exactly16 programmed targets (500+125*k ms, k0..15) without neural input. An authentic result has not been measured. Event timing accuracy cannot establish neural understanding on that target.
scoring.comparison: DUNL, published peak-finding curve, train-only matched filter and schedule-only detector; count/period/phase assistance identical.

protected_split: Whole trials and authenticated animal/recording groups; historical paper split held until final supplement join. TRAIN/DEV-only tuning and held inference remain separate. Do not force25/25 or silently repair30/20.
custody_disposition: Root determined the preceding DUNL raw archive cap exceeded the shared allowance: preserve historical noncompliance, no deletion/splitting/retroactive compliance. Scientific/source finding retained; oversized archive not reread in this phase.
distinctness: Critical reproduction of sparse deconvolution with deterministic schedule assistance; no registered same DOI/code/whisker endpoint found. Other DUNL modalities are excluded, not extra tasks.
